notes.title: Psychotic Nightmare now with MORE than 25% OFF FOREVER!
notes.content:
28% OFF!
You read that right! Psychotic Nightmare is NOW available for just €4.99, which is a 28% discount from the original price of [strike]€6.99[/strike].
A psychotic deal, don’t you think? Especially since it’s FOREVER. ;)

Take this chance to dive into the dark hallways of your school, the origin of your psychotic episodes, and confront your deepest fears embodied in shadowy forms.

[previewyoutube=wPl-L2YqaZg;full][/previewyoutube]

But... Why?
I believe this new price better reflects the overall experience of the game, even if it doesn’t fully account for the countless hours spent developing it. My goal is to bring more players into the Psychotic Nightmare community and let them enjoy this unique psychological horror adventure.

I can’t wait to see your gameplay videos, reviews, and all the amazing content you create!

And to everyone who supported the game from the beginning, I can’t thank you enough! You’re truly incredible. ;)
